title: symphyotrichum patens
intro: Symphyotrichum patens, commonly known as the large white aster, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. It is used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The large white aster has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, such as digestive problems and respiratory infections, through its therapeutic actions, including astringent and expectorant properties. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
